blocks.text: Sulphuric acid pani mein hal ho jata hai aur hygroscopic hai, yani hawa se pani ke bukharat (water vapour) aasani se jazb kar leta hai. Bina pani wala (anhydrous) H₂SO₄ bohat polar liquid hai. Yeh bohat si cheezon ko kha jata (corrosive) hai, aur jild (skin) par lag jaye to kimiyai jalan (chemical burn) deta hai. Is ki kuch physical properties Table 12.5 mein hain.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ki ibarat 'Table 12.4' kehti hai, magar sulphuric acid ki properties Table 12.5 mein hain; Table 12.4 sulfur ki table hai.

blocks.caption: Table 12.5 Sulphuric acid ki physical properties

blocks.title: Khabardar (warning)
blocks.text: Sulphuric acid bohat corrosive hai: yeh kapre, plastic aur rubber ko buri tarah jala deta hai aur insaan ki jild aur aankhon ko zakhmi kar deta hai. Ise bohat ehtiyat se istemal karein (kitab ki table ki aakhri row, khatre ke nishan ke saath).

blocks.prompt: Concentrated sulphuric acid ko dilute karte waqt acid pani mein kyun dalte hain, pani acid mein kyun nahi?
blocks.explanation: Acid ka pani mein milna bohat garmi deta hai. Agar thora pani gaarhe acid mein dalein to pani foran ubal kar acid ke chheente urata hai. Acid ko zyada pani mein aahista aahista, hilate hue dalne se garmi pani mein phail jati hai aur khatra nahi hota.

items: H₂SO₄: be-rang, gaarha (viscous), be-boo, hygroscopic; anhydrous ho to bohat polar.
Melting point 10 °C, boiling point 290 °C, specific gravity 1.83; bohat corrosive.
